The Indian Men’s Hockey Team delivered a thrilling performance against Pakistan in their final Pool D clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, securing a 5–3 victory in a high-intensity encounter.
India produced a clinical attacking display in the iconic rivalry, finding the net five times to seal a memorable win and finish second in Pool D. The victory also saw India book their place in the next phase of the tournament and keep their semifinal hopes alive.
